title: Single-chain and condensed-state behavior of hnRNPA1 from molecular simulations
authors: Bauer DJ; Stelzl LS; Nikoubashman A
one_liner_zh: 该文用粗粒化隐式溶剂分子动力学模拟系统研究hnRNPA1低复杂度域的单链构象与凝聚态相行为，揭示芳香残基对IDP相分离/凝聚体形成的驱动作用及静电驱动的密度不均匀性，直接命中无序蛋白互作与物理模拟机制建模主题。
abstract: Intrinsically disordered proteins (IDPs) are essential components for the formation of membraneless organelles, which play key functional and regulatory roles within biological systems. These complex assemblies form and dissolve spontaneously over time via liquid-liquid phase separation of IDPs. Mutations in their amino acid sequence can alter their phase behavior, which has been linked to the emergence of severe diseases such as cancer and neurodegenerative diseases including amyotrophic lateral sclerosis. In this work, we study the conformation and phase behavior of a low-complexity domain of heterogeneous nuclear ribonucleoprotein A1 (hnRNPA1), using coarse-grained implicit solvent molecular dynamics simulations. We systematically analyze how these properties are affected by the number of aromatic residues within the examined sequences. We find a significant compaction of the chains and an increase in the critical temperature with increasing number of aromatic residues within the IDPs. Comparing single-chain and condensed state simulations, we find much more collapsed polymer conformations in the dilute systems, even at temperatures well above the estimated θ -temperature of the solution. These observations strongly support the hypothesis that aromatic residues play a dominant role for condensation, which is further corroborated by a detailed analysis of the intermolecular contacts, and conversely that important properties of condensates are captured in coarse-grained simulations. Interestingly, we observe density inhomogeneities within the condensates near criticality, which are driven by electrostatic interactions. Finally, we find that the relatively small fraction of hydrophobic residues in the IDPs results in interfacial tensions which are significantly lower compared to typical combinations of immiscible simple liquids.
abstract_zh: intrinsically disordered proteins (IDPs) 是无膜细胞器形成的关键组分，这些细胞器在生物系统中发挥重要的功能和调控作用。这些复杂组装体通过IDPs的液-液相分离随时间自发形成和溶解。其氨基酸序列中的突变可改变其相行为，这与严重疾病的发生相关，如癌症和包括肌萎缩侧索硬化在内的神经退行性疾病。在本工作中，我们使用粗粒化隐式溶剂分子动力学模拟，研究了异质核核糖核蛋白A1 (hnRNPA1) 的低复杂度结构域的结构和相行为。我们系统分析了这些性质如何受所检查序列中芳香族残基数目的影响。我们发现，随着IDPs中芳香族残基数目的增加，链显著压缩，临界温度升高。通过比较单链和凝聚态模拟，我们发现即使在远高于溶液估计θ-温度的条件下，稀体系中的聚合物构象也更为塌缩。这些观察强烈支持芳香族残基在凝聚中起主导作用的假设，这通过分子间接触的详细分析得到进一步证实，反之，凝聚体的重要性质在粗粒化模拟中得以捕获。有趣的是，我们观察到接近临界点时凝聚体内存在由静电相互作用驱动的密度不均匀性。最后，我们发现IDPs中相对较小比例的疏水残基导致界面张力显著低于典型不混溶简单液体组合的值。
